```
TokenBucket(capacity: int, refill_rate: float)
  - Capacity: max tokens in bucket (burst size)

  - Thread-safe with internal lock

allow(tokens: int = 1) -> bool

  - Returns False if insufficient tokens (no state change)
  - Auto-refills based on elapsed time
  - Refill capped at capacity
```
